title: Z-DNA formation in promoters conserved between human and mouse are associated with increased transcription reinitiation rates.
authors: Beknazarov, Nazar; Konovalov, Dmitry; Herbert, Alan; Poptsova, Maria
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习预测Z-DNA形成位点并研究其与转录再起始的关系，虽涉及DNA结构预测和转录调控，但核心是Z-DNA而非TF-DNA结合互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: A long-standing question concerns the role of Z-DNA in transcription. Here we use a deep learning approach DeepZ that predicts Z-flipons based on DNA sequence, structural properties of nucleotides and omics data. We examined Z-flipons that are conserved between human and mouse genomes after generating whole-genome Z-flipon maps and then validated them by orthogonal approaches based on high resolution chemical mapping of Z-DNA and the transformer algorithm Z-DNABERT. For human and mouse, we revealed similar pattern of transcription factors, chromatin remodelers, and histone marks associated with conserved Z-flipons. We found significant enrichment of Z-flipons in alternative and bidirectional promoters associated with neurogenesis genes. We show that conserved Z-flipons are associated with increased experimentally determined transcription reinitiation rates compared to promoters without Z-flipons, but without affecting elongation or pausing. Our findings support a model where Z-flipons engage Transcription Factor E and impact phenotype by enabling the reset of preinitiation complexes when active, and the suppression of gene expression when engaged by repressive chromatin complexes.
abstract_zh: 一个长期存在的问题涉及Z-DNA在转录中的作用。在此，我们采用深度学习方法DeepZ，基于DNA序列、核苷酸结构特性及组学数据预测Z-flipons。在生成全基因组Z-flipon图谱后，我们检查了人类与小鼠基因组间保守的Z-flipons，并通过基于Z-DNA高分辨率化学图谱和转换器算法Z-DNABERT的正交方法对其进行了验证。对于人类和小鼠，我们揭示了与保守Z-flipons相关的转录因子、染色质重塑因子及组蛋白标记的相似模式。我们发现Z-flipons在神经发生基因相关的替代启动子和双向启动子中显著富集。我们表明，与不含Z-flipons的启动子相比，保守Z-flipons与实验测定的转录再起始速率增加相关，但不影响延伸或暂停。我们的发现支持一个模型，其中Z-flipons与转录因子E结合，并通过在活跃时重置预起始复合物、在被抑制性染色质复合物结合时抑制基因表达来影响表型。
